art_direction: 圆拱短眼共望左上，下缘轻薄，留白像宽折角，一侧短眉略高。
composition: centered hand-drawn eye pair; auxiliary marks only when specified; large blank paper margins

color_randomization.method: golden-angle hue spacing with seeded single-hue saturation and lightness variation

color_treatment: one opaque flat color beside each pupil; no gradient or shaded rendering
creative_direction: Draw two short rounded upper arches with a fine pen, leaving their lower curves light and partial. Both generous black pupils look toward the upper left. Cut a broad folded-corner paper shape from each pupil, different in contour but similar in scale. Keep the iris accents compact and flat. Raise one short eyebrow only slightly while the other lies close above its eye. Let one inner contour remain open. The expression is a small question, not surprise. No mouth or repeated hatching.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
